---
name: Feature request
about: Use this template to propose a new capability or improvement to the agent.
---

### The problem
Describe the problem you have or the workflow gap this would address.

### Tier or agent
If relevant, name which tier (0 through 3) or which coding agent this concerns.

### Proposed solution
What you would like to see added or changed, in as much or as little detail as you have.

### Pull request
Could you send a pull request? If yes, see `CONTRIBUTING.md` for how.

### What not to include
Do not paste credentials, real IP addresses, or customer names. Security issues go to `SECURITY.md`, not here.
